displayedInputs.question: Each box contains 125 bottles. How many bottles are there in 16 boxes altogether? Calculate: \(125 \times 16 = ?\)
Two lines intersect at a right angle. What is their positional relationship?
A flagpole meets the ground at a right angle. How many degrees is this angle? Calculate: \(45 + 45 = ?\)
What is the relationship between two lines in the same plane that do not intersect?

choices.A: They are parallel to each other
choices.B: They are perpendicular to each other

displayedInputs.question: The two rails of a railway track are parallel. If a section of one rail is 20 meters long and a section of the other is also 20 meters long, how many meters do the two sections differ in length? Calculate: \(20-20=?\)
There are 288 notebooks, with 16 notebooks tied into each bundle. How many bundles can be made? Calculate: \(288\div16=?\)
In \(600\div30\), one 0 can be removed from each number, so first calculate \(60\div3\). What is \(60\div3\)? Calculate: \(60\div3=?\)
A bar chart has one bar for each category, and its vertical axis shows the number of items. What does the height of each bar directly show?

choices.A: The number of items in that category
choices.B: How the number of items changes over time
choices.C: The percentage of the total in that category

displayedInputs.question: 15 people like apples, and 9 people like bananas. How many more people like apples than bananas? Calculate: \(15-9=?\)
The numbers of books borrowed over 4 days are 8, 6, 10, and 4. Which 2 days have a combined total of 14 books? First calculate \(8+6\). Calculate: \(8+6=?\)
How should tasks be arranged in an optimization problem?

choices.B: Do all tasks separately; the slower, the better

displayedInputs.question: Cooking 1 flatbread takes 3 minutes, and the pan can cook 2 flatbreads at the same time. What is the minimum number of minutes needed to cook 2 flatbreads? Calculate: \(3+0=?\)

Walking takes 10 minutes, and buying tickets takes 2 minutes. If 1 person goes to buy tickets first and the 2 tasks are done one after another, how many minutes are needed in total? Calculate: \(10+2=?\)
The sum of 2 numbers is 70, and 1 of them is 28. What is the other number? Calculate: \(70-28=?\)
There are 24 storybooks and 18 science and technology books. How many books are there in total? Calculate: \(24+18=?\)
